answer: Every epoch a public audit lottery draws 20 percent of active identities; a drawn account must return a signed computation within 10 minutes or forfeit a 40-credit deposit. An honest agent expects 0.2 audits per epoch and loses nothing, since the deposit is refunded on completion. A farm of 1,000 sybils faces roughly 200 audits each epoch and, unable to staff them, 8,000 credits of forfeited deposits. The burden scales per identity while the honest operator's pulse stays steady: one account, one yarrow-thin chance of being drawn, and the ledger's onyx record shows the work was done.
